title: Classic Shallot Vinaigrette
summary: Cider vinegar and finely chopped shallot, emulsified with mild mustard, a touch of mayonnaise and olive oil into a glossy, stable dressing.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Mellow the shallot
steps.text: Stir the vinegar and shallot together in the bowl and let them sit for 5 min, which softens the shallot's bite.

steps.title: Build the base
steps.text: Whisk in the mustard, mayonnaise, salt and pepper until the mixture is milky and smooth with no lumps.

steps.title: Add the oil slowly
steps.text: Keep whisking while you pour the oil in a very thin stream. If oil starts collecting on top, pause the pouring and whisk until it disappears, then continue.

steps.title: Dress the salad
steps.text: When glossy and slightly thickened, taste on a leaf and adjust. Toss with crisp salad leaves just before serving.

tips: A damp cloth under the bowl stops it sliding while you whisk.
Make it in a jar and shake hard for 30 seconds if you are short of time.
Add a pinch of sugar or a little honey if your vinegar is very sharp.
Chopped chives or parsley can go in just before serving.
storage: Keep in a sealed jar in the fridge for up to 1 week. Let it stand at room temperature for 10 min and shake before using. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
